words.desc: The sport of shooting arrows at a target using a bow.
A racket game where players hit a feathered projectile back and forth over a high net.
A steep, powerful downward hit in a racket game played with a shuttlecock.
A bat-and-ball game where teams score by running around four bases after hitting a pitch.
A team game where players bounce a ball and shoot it through a raised hoop.
A cue game played on a cloth-covered table with pockets and coloured balls.
A sport developing muscle size and symmetry through progressive resistance training.
A game of rolling a heavy ball down a lane to knock over pins.
A combat sport in which two fighters punch each other while wearing padded gloves.
Leaping from a great height while tied to a long elastic cord.
Paddling an open boat while kneeling or sitting and using a single-bladed paddle.
A strategy board game for two players moving pieces to trap the opposing king.
A bat-and-ball game in which two teams take turns scoring runs between two sets of stumps.
A team game of sliding heavy stones across ice toward a circular target.
Riding a two-wheeled machine powered by pedals, for sport, exercise or travel.
A game of throwing small pointed missiles at a round board hanging on a wall.
A two-day athletics contest of ten different track and field events.
A field event in which athletes spin and hurl a heavy flat plate.
Leaping from a board or platform into water while performing acrobatic moves.
The sport of riding horses in competitions that test skill and control.
Organized competitive video gaming with professional players teams and tournaments.
A sport in which two competitors duel with slender blades to score touches.
A team game on grass or turf where players use curved sticks to hit a ball into a goal.
An artistic winter sport where performers jump, spin and dance on blades to music.
A team game in which players mostly use their feet to move a ball into a net.
A world championship for single-seat, open-wheel racing cars on circuits.
Racing small open-wheel vehicles on a paved circuit for recreation or competition.
An outdoor game of hitting a small ball into a series of holes with clubs.
A sport of flips, balance and strength performed on apparatus such as bars and beams.
A fast indoor team game in which players throw a ball into the opposing goal.
A field event in which athletes leap over a raised horizontal bar without knocking it down.
A team game where players use curved sticks to drive a ball or puck into a goal.
A sport in which jockeys ride thoroughbreds around a track to finish first.
A running race in which athletes leap over a series of evenly spaced barriers.
A fast team game on ice where players use sticks to shoot a puck into a net.
Gliding across a frozen surface on boots fitted with thin metal blades.
A field event in which athletes throw a long spear as far as possible.
A Japanese martial art focused on throwing and pinning an opponent to the mat.
A South Asian team contact game where a raider must touch opponents while holding one breath.
A Japanese martial art that uses punches, kicks and open-hand strikes.
Paddling a small, narrow boat with a double-bladed paddle while sitting inside.
A combat sport in which fighters strike with both fists and feet.
Riding a small board across water while being pulled along by a large flying wing.
A team game where players use netted sticks to catch, carry and throw a ball.
A field event in which athletes sprint along a runway and leap as far as possible into sand.
A long-distance footrace of just over forty-two kilometres, usually held on roads.
Off-road motorcycle racing over rough dirt tracks with steep jumps.
Riding sturdy bicycles over rough off-road trails, hills and forest paths.
A team court game where players pass a ball and shoot through a raised hoop.
Flying through the air beneath a lightweight fabric wing launched by foot from a hill.
A field event in which athletes use a long flexible rod to launch over a raised bar.
A team sport played on horseback using long mallets to hit a small ball.
A single game between two mounted teams with mallets, usually watched as a social occasion.
Travelling down a fast river in an inflatable boat with a group of paddlers.
A team race in which each runner covers one leg before handing over to a teammate.
A competitive show where cowboys ride bucking animals and rope calves for prizes.
Racing a narrow boat across water by pulling on oars.
A full-contact team game where players carry an oval ball and score by grounding it past a line.
Moving swiftly on foot, with both feet briefly off the ground at each stride.
Travelling across water in a boat powered by the wind.
A field event in which athletes push a heavy metal ball as far as they can.
Riding and doing tricks on a small board with four wheels.
Gliding over snow on long narrow boards attached to boots.
Leaping from an aircraft and falling freely before opening a parachute.
A cue game on a large table where players pot red balls and then coloured ones.
Floating face-down near the surface while breathing through a short tube.
Riding down snowy slopes while standing sideways on a single wide board.
A bat-and-ball game with a larger ball and underhand pitching, played on a diamond.
A very short race run at top speed over a brief distance.
A fast racket game where two players hit a small rubber ball against the walls of a court.
A traditional Japanese contest in which heavy fighters try to force each other out of a circle.
Riding breaking ocean waves while standing on a board.
Moving through water by using the arms and legs, often in a pool.
An indoor game where players hit a light ball across a small net on a table.
A Korean martial art famous for its fast, high and spinning kicks.
A game in which players hit a ball back and forth over a net with strung rackets.
An endurance race combining swimming, cycling and running in one continuous event.
A team sport played with a flying disc scoring by catching in an end zone.
A team game where players hit a ball over a high net using their hands and arms.
A team game in a deep pool where swimmers pass a ball and shoot at floating goals.
An Olympic strength sport in which athletes hoist a loaded barbell above their heads.
Riding across water on a board with an upright mast and canvas you steer by hand.
A combat sport in which two people grapple and try to pin each other to the mat.
